title: Assessing the Fairness of AI Systems: AI Practitioners’ Processes, Challenges, and Needs for Support
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It is a qualitative study of AI practitioners' processes for assessing fairness in AI systems, focusing on challenges with disaggregated evaluations based on demographics like race, gender, and age.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
